title.zh: 分数 · 把整体平均切开来数
title.en: Fractions · cutting the whole into equal parts

description.zh: 分数是一个数，不是上下摆着的两个数：分母说把整体平均切成几份，分子说取了其中几份；1/2、2/4、4/8 是同一个数换了写法，分母不同的分数要先通分才能比大小和相加。
description.en: A fraction is one number, not two stacked numbers: the denominator says how many equal parts the whole is cut into and the numerator how many are taken; 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 are one number written differently, and fractions with different denominators must share a common denominator before comparing or adding.

label.zh: 分数先占住数轴上的点
label.en: Fractions claim points on the number line first

reason.zh: 分数、小数、百分数同值就落在数轴同一点；有了这些分数点，才会问出 √2 这样的数为什么写不成分数、却仍在数轴上有位置。
reason.en: Fractions, decimals and percents of equal value land on the same point of the number line; once those points are filled in, it is natural to ask why a number like √2 cannot be written as a fraction yet still has a place on the line.

label.zh: 除法是两种写法之间的翻译
label.en: Division translates between the two forms

reason.zh: 7/4 就是 7 ÷ 4：商 1、余 3，写成带分数 1¾——余数正好成了带分数里分数部分的分子。
reason.en: 7/4 is 7 ÷ 4: quotient 1, remainder 3, written as the mixed number 1¾ — the remainder becomes the numerator of the fractional part.

ask.zh: 1/2 和 1/3 的格子一样大吗？不一样大的格子能直接数在一起吗？
ask.en: Are halves and thirds the same size? Can pieces of different sizes be counted together directly?

ask.zh: 把 1/2、1/3 和 2/5 放到数轴上，2/5 比 1/2 大还是小？
ask.en: Place 1/2, 1/3 and 2/5 on the number line — is 2/5 bigger or smaller than 1/2?

reveal.zh: 分母不同，格子大小就不同，不能直接把分子、分母各自相加；2/5 甚至比 1/2 还小。先通分成六分之几：3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6。
reveal.en: Different denominators mean different-sized pieces, so numerators and denominators cannot simply be added; 2/5 is even smaller than 1/2. Convert to sixths first: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
